# TrueSkill Academy

> Expert chess coaching for ambitious young minds. Structured programs from beginner to advanced with live sessions, tactical training, and tournament preparation.

## Programs

- `Beginner Chess Program -> https://atrueskill.academy/programs/beginner`: Foundation program for new players — board setup, notation, opening principles, and basic checkmates. 2 sessions/week, 45 minutes. From INR 2,999.
- `Post-Beginner Chess Program -> https://atrueskill.academy/programs/post-beginner`: Bridge from rules to strategy — forks, pins, skewers, opening traps, and elementary endgames. 2 sessions/week, 60 minutes. From INR 3,999.
- `Intermediate Chess Coaching -> https://atrueskill.academy/programs/intermediate`: Sharper calculation, positional play, and tournament habits — calculation trees, minor piece strategy, rook endings. 3 sessions/week, 60 minutes. From INR 5,499.
- `Advanced Chess Program -> https://atrueskill.academy/programs/advanced`: Elite tournament preparation — deep analysis, repertoire sophistication, opponent-specific prep, one-to-one coaching. Custom pricing.

## Key Pages

- `All Programs -> https://atrueskill.academy/programs`: Overview of all four coaching levels with pricing and schedules.
- `Advantages of Chess -> https://atrueskill.academy/advantages`: Cognitive, emotional, educational, and social benefits of chess for students.
- `Careers -> https://atrueskill.academy/careers`: Chess coaching positions — qualifications, responsibilities, and application.
- `Contact -> https://atrueskill.academy/contact`: Enquiry form, email (hello@atrueskill.academy), and phone contact.

## Key Facts

- Four structured levels: Beginner, Post-Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced
- Live coaching sessions with expert instructors
- Programs designed for children and adults
- Pricing starts from INR 2,999/month
- Based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- Online and in-person coaching available
